name: emblem-multilang
description: Tiny dependency-free multi-language (i18n) for browser apps. Two engines: emblem-multilang-auto.js drops into an existing app and auto-translates the rendered English via a MutationObserver (29-language registry, RTL, no string wrapping); emblem-multilang.js is a key-based helper for new apps. Language switcher, interpolation, browser-language detect, persistence, graceful fallback. Runs under a strict CSP.
